title: The One Direction Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "One Direction". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which TV talent show did One Direction form on in 2010?
questions.answerNote: They were put together as a group after failing solo auditions.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction member left the band in 2015?
questions.answerNote: Zayn Malik departed in March 2015 to pursue a solo career.

questions.prompt: What was One Direction's debut single in 2011?
questions.answerNote: It reached number one on the UK singles chart in September 2011.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction member is from Mullingar, Ireland?
questions.answerNote: Niall was the only Irish member of the band.

questions.prompt: What was the title of One Direction's debut studio album?
questions.answerNote: Up All Night was released in November 2011.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction single features the lyric "You don't know you're beautiful"?
questions.answerNote: It became their breakthrough debut single in 2011.

questions.prompt: In which year did One Direction announce their hiatus?
questions.answerNote: The hiatus was announced in August 2015, taking effect from 2016.

questions.prompt: Which of these was NOT a One Direction studio album?
questions.answerNote: Fearless is a Taylor Swift album, not a One Direction one.

questions.prompt: Which member of One Direction is from Bradford, West Yorkshire?
questions.answerNote: Zayn later returned to music with his solo debut Mind of Mine.

questions.prompt: Which record label signed One Direction after The X Factor?
questions.answerNote: Syco Music, run by Simon Cowell, signed the band in 2010.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction song was used as the theme for their 2013 documentary film?
questions.answerNote: Best Song Ever promoted the film This Is Us.

questions.prompt: What is the title of One Direction's 2013 concert documentary film?
questions.answerNote: It was directed by Morgan Spurlock.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction member released the solo single "Strip That Down" in 2017?
questions.answerNote: It featured rapper Quavo and reached the UK top five.

questions.prompt: What is the title of Louis Tomlinson's debut solo album, released in 2020?
options: Copy of a Copy of a Copy
questions.answerNote: Walls came out in January 2020, his first full solo album.

questions.prompt: Which stadium tour did One Direction embark on in 2014?
questions.answerNote: It was one of the highest-grossing tours of that year.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction song features the lyric "Baby you light up my world like nobody else"?
questions.answerNote: It's the opening line of their debut single.

questions.prompt: One Direction's "Drag Me Down" was the lead single from which album?
questions.answerNote: It was the first single released after Zayn Malik's departure.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction member has a tattoo collection famously featuring a ship on his arm?
questions.answerNote: Harry Styles has a large ship tattoo on his forearm.

questions.prompt: In which year did One Direction perform at the London 2012 Olympics closing ceremony?
questions.answerNote: They performed What Makes You Beautiful at the closing ceremony.

questions.prompt: Which One Direction song was co-written by Ed Sheeran?
questions.answerNote: Ed Sheeran co-wrote Little Things, released in 2012.
